children.name: webkit
moviecatalog/a11y.test.ts
Accessibility
login page has no critical violations
movie list page has no critical violations
add-movie form is accessible at the element level
movie detail page has no critical violations
moviecatalog/auth.test.ts
Authentication & session
valid login navigates to the movie list
invalid credentials show an inline error
a mocked 401 from the login endpoint shows the same inline error
unauthenticated access to a protected route redirects to /login
a 401 on any authenticated call logs out and shows a popup (mocked)
logout button clears the session
moviecatalog/detail.test.ts
Movie detail
studio ID resolves to studio name
nonexistent MID shows a not-found message (mocked)
edit and delete sit in separate left/right cells
confirming delete from the detail page returns to the list
moviecatalog/err.test.ts
Global error popup
a 5XX on any call shows a refreshable popup (mocked)
dismissing the popup is non-destructive
4XX popup coexists with a field-specific error, 401 popup suppresses the page entirely
a network failure falls through to the component’s own error, not the popup
moviecatalog/list.test.ts
Movie list
search is debounced to a single request
no search matches shows the empty state (mocked)
rating + price filters combine and reset to page 0
sort toggles direction on repeated clicks
pagination buttons disable at both boundaries (mocked)
delete confirmation flow and auto-dismissing toast
canceling a pending delete leaves the row intact

moviecatalog/movie.test.ts
Add/Edit movie
all required-field errors surface together on empty submit
server-side validation errors map to the right fields (mocked)
duplicate MID (409) clears the field and flags it (mocked)
successful add navigates to the list with a success banner
edit mode pre-fills the form and locks the MID
submit stays disabled until the whole form is valid
moviecatalog/net.test.ts
Network mocking depth
network failure on the initial list load falls through to the component’s own error
wildcard pattern mocks every movie-detail request
changing a filter issues exactly one new request
the UI stays usable while a request is artificially slow
moviecatalog/nfr.test.ts
Cross-cutting / non-functional
keyboard-only path through login → search → detail → back
no native dialogs anywhere in the delete flow
moviecatalog/perf.test.ts
Performance budgets
movie list loads within budget
JS heap stays within budget after paging and filtering (Chromium only)
add-movie round trip completes within a time threshold
